lines.text: Nahum the Elkoshite's vision is a burden against Nineveh, and the LORD is slow to anger yet will not leave the guilty unpunished.
The LORD dries up the sea and rivers, the mountains quake before Him, and even rocks are shattered.
The LORD is a stronghold for those who trust in Him, and with a raging fire He will end Nineveh.
The LORD says the allied and numerous will be cut down, and He will break Judah's yoke and tear away its shackles.
The LORD will prepare a grave for Nineveh, and Nahum tells Judah to mourn and fast because the wicked are cut off.
